source_snapshot.items: PMIC Fatal Error - VIN Bulk Input Only
source_snapshot.procedure: Applies shared PMIC/I2C settings, then gives a split 0:0:3 railtype4/voltagetype0/dimm0 command, requests immediate reset and repetition for every DIMM with voltage types0/1.
source_snapshot.criteria: Uncorrectable tool PASS and an OS report without a defined VIN-specific status, electrical range or deadline.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic power/PMIC log filtering cannot discriminate upstream VIN from downstream switch rails.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Keeps railtype4 and serialized execution but leaves input-source mapping, comparator meaning and downstream recovery unauthoritative.

old_problem: The all-DIMM dual-voltage scope has only one fixed, syntactically split tuple. No authority proves railtype4 is VIN bulk input only, defines comparator direction, binds each PMIC to an input source/I2C address, or supplies electrical and recovery criteria.
disposition_reason: Unlike a runtime IP or BDF, the input-rail selector and comparator direction determine which power domain is disturbed. ED-03/12/15/16 require vendor command semantics, authoritative thresholds and a recoverable destructive procedure, so this remains Pending/BLOCKED rather than parameterized-ready.
decision_basis: Read exact Reliability row92/history2490 and separately verified the adjacent SWD and critical-temperature cases.
Preserved every DIMM, both voltage selectors, railtype4, immediate reset and the PMIC/I2C configuration intent.
Required VIN-source-to-PMIC topology and simultaneous downstream-rail observation to distinguish an upstream event.
Required complete boot, DIMM-training and memory restoration before another tuple.
Did not join the command, infer comparator direction, touch the DUT, inject, reset or retry.

test_case.test_name: DDR5 PMIC VIN bulk-input fatal and downstream recovery matrix
test_case.purpose: For each approved PMIC/DIMM and VIN comparator, inject one VIN-bulk-input-only fatal condition, prove the upstream source rather than SWA-SWD caused the reset, and restore the input, downstream rails and memory service.
required_package: Vendor proof for railtype4 and voltagetype0/1 direction/threshold semantics
Per-DIMM PMIC part/address plus VIN source and downstream-rail topology
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/OOB ownership mapping
Approved complete command and explicit tuple population
VIN/current/thermal and downstream-rail limits, source-specific status oracle and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the ambiguous source lines. After authority is signed, baseline the mapped VIN source, downstream rails, PMIC status, SPD/I2C and memory; inject one exact railtype4 comparator once under OOB/electrical capture; correlate VIN-specific durable evidence and reset; restore all power and management state and validate memory before any next tuple.
test_case.expected_result: The intended PMIC reports the authorized VIN input fatal source and the host completes the expected reset/OS-ready transition; VIN and every downstream rail return within signed limits, all DIMMs train/enumerate, bounded memory passes and configuration matches baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact input-source/address/comparator proof, fresh VIN-specific status, an approved timeline and complete downstream/memory restoration. Generic PMIC logs, another rail event, guessed direction, unsafe voltage/current/temperature, missing DIMM or state drift is FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated instrumented DDR5 SUT with independent console and VIN/downstream telemetry.
One PMIC/comparator per authorization; no target loop.
Abort on wrong VIN source/status, downstream instability, limit breach, management-bus loss, abnormal reset or DIMM-training failure.
No automatic retry, reset or continuation.
expected_evidence: Raw VIN/downstream rail, PMIC, SPD/I2C and memory baseline
Exact tuple and OOB reset-to-ready chronology
Fresh VIN-specific PMIC and CPER/BERT/SEL fields
Recovered input/downstream telemetry, full DIMM inventory, bounded memory result and configuration diff
test_case.recovery: Restore VIN/PMIC mode and fault recovery, SPD host control, telemetry polling, I2C enables and BIOS/HDT settings; verify stable downstream rails, retrain all DIMMs and run bounded memory validation. Use only the approved OOB/hardware recovery path if power or training does not return.

source_conflict.reason: A single fixed tuple and undefined line continuation do not cover the requested PMIC population or comparator directions, and the input-only acceptance contract is absent.

blocked.reason: An incorrect upstream VIN fault can collapse multiple downstream rails and prevent safe boot or DDR5 recovery.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: VIN rail/comparator authority, input/PMIC/I2C topology, executable tuple syntax, electrical limits, durable oracle and recovery.
